# glinet_clients (Data Source)

Read the DHCP lease table reported by the router. The lease table is runtime state, so the result changes without a configuration change.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `clients` (List of Object) Active DHCP leases. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clients))

<a id="nestedatt--clients"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clients`

Read-Only:

- `client_id` (String)
- `hostname` (String)
- `ip` (String)
- `lease_seconds` (Number)
- `mac` (String)
